goal: Determine whether a low-cost bacterial-cellulose sorbent remains selective, buoyant, retrievable and mechanically recoverable under saltwater and controlled dynamic-water conditions before any petroleum or open-water field claim is considered.

stage_0_coupon_gate.chain: GREEN vs BLACK -> D0-D3 drying -> 50x50 coupons -> oil/water test -> press recovery
stage_0_coupon_gate.advance_rule: Advance only the best one or two branches by joint yield, oil uptake, water uptake, selectivity, retention, integrity, reproducibility and estimated process cost.

stage_1_marine_pad.M1A: STATIC FRESH WATER vs ARTIFICIAL SEAWATER 35±2 PSU, n=3 per branch/condition
stage_1_marine_pad.M1B: DYNAMIC ARTIFICIAL SEAWATER with frozen rocking/recirculation history, n=5 per lead branch

promotion_gates.M1_G1: Median surrogate-oil uptake >= 10 g/g in artificial seawater.
promotion_gates.M1_G4: Dry-equivalent sorbent retrieval >= 99% with no hazardous fragmentation.
promotion_gates.M1_G5: Single contained press recovers >= 60% initially absorbed surrogate oil if closed-loop recovery is claimed.
promotion_gates.M1_G7: Dynamic marine performance >= 80% matched static marine performance.
promotion_gates.M1_G8: Lead result reproduced in at least two independent BC production batches.
promotion_gates.boundary: Internal engineering gates, not regulatory thresholds.

stage_2_boom_cartridge.core_reason: The sleeve contains any BC damage or fragments and converts the sorbent into one recoverable marine object.
stage_2_boom_cartridge.workflow: DEPLOY -> SORB -> RETRIEVE WHOLE -> CONTAINED DRAIN/PRESS -> COLLECT OIL/WATER -> PHASE SEPARATE -> CHARACTERIZE RECOVERED OIL -> CONTROLLED SPENT-BC ROUTE
stage_2_boom_cartridge.advance_rule: Remain positively buoyant, fully retrievable, contain its BC, preserve >=80% pad-level g/g performance and show a measured cost-per-recovered-oil reason to continue against reference control.

cost_down_gate.objective: Optimize recovered oil per unit cost rather than maximum publication-grade g/g.

janus_tranception.forward: BC_PRODUCTION -> POROUS_PAD -> MARINE_OIL_CONTACT -> SELECTIVE_UPTAKE -> DYNAMIC_EXPOSURE -> RETRIEVE -> CONTAINED_PRESS -> RECOVERED_OIL -> CONTROLLED_SPENT_BC
janus_tranception.reverse: RECOVERED_OIL -> REQUIRES_PRESS/DRAIN -> REQUIRES_FULL_RETRIEVAL -> REQUIRES_DYNAMIC_SURVIVAL -> REQUIRES_OIL_OVER_WATER_SELECTIVITY -> REQUIRES_RETRIEVABLE_POROUS_BC -> REQUIRES_REPRODUCIBLE_BC
janus_tranception.promotion_rule: No field claim until measured forward execution and reverse audit close the same critical edges.

safety_and_environment.petroleum_transition: Only in an appropriately controlled laboratory with chemical/fire/environmental/waste controls.
prohibited: shredding or abandoning sorbent in the environment

regulatory_and_method_anchors.note: Marine environment protection — specifications on design and selection of sorbents; confirmed current after 2023 review.

regulatory_and_method_anchors.resource: Application of Sorbents and Solidifiers for Oil Spills

next_action: Finish the 50x50 Stage-0 screen if still open; then fabricate 100x100 mm pads from the top one or two branches and run M1A fresh-vs-artificial-seawater static tests before dynamic testing.
